purpose: Source-specific native-original availability, web-rendered composition and underlying-art provenance review for three still-held historical KEEP choices. This is research only and does not promote or replace any user-approved image.

method.web_source_file_pages: Opened exact Wikimedia Commons file pages and original-file renders
method.rights_review: Photographer license verified on source page; underlying object historical age independently sourced where available; no jurisdiction-specific final legal clearance
method.editorial_review: Preserve historical KEEP unchanged; do not replace with research alternatives.

subjects.visually_verified_subject: Correct gold-and-glass Saint Bernadette reliquary; flower bouquet across large foreground; face and body occupy limited image area.
subjects.underlying_object_note: Face and hands have wax coverings created in 1925 by Pierre Imans firm, not the saint's unaltered visible skin.
subjects.next_action: Evaluate the existing KEEP image only as accurately captioned environmental gallery view if legal and editorial gates clear; find separately sourced tighter view as unapproved research candidate. Do not auto-crop, substitute or infer release.

subjects.visually_verified_subject: Correct Mariazell Magna Mater dressed statue inside elaborate silver altar. Statue small relative to total portrait frame; altar and decorations dominate.
subjects.underlying_object_note: Original medieval statue distinct from removable clothing, metal decorations, jewellery and other adornment; do not assume copyright status of every modern accessory.
subjects.next_action: Retain for context-gallery consideration subject to rights/editorial clearance; evaluate separately sourced exact-statue closeup as a candidate, never replace historical KEEP automatically.

subjects.visually_verified_subject: Correct historic silver casket of St Francis Xavier at Basilica of Bom Jesus, but noisy, dim, and soft with low casket contrast.
subjects.underlying_object_note: Silversmiths made original casket in 1636–37, subsequently set above late-17th-century Foggini mausoleum; underlying historical art almost certainly past ordinary copyright term. This is evidence of date, not blanket rights clearance.
subjects.next_action: Do not publish as premium exact-object media; preserve historical KEEP and check quality against separately sourced candidate.

unapproved_research_alternative.composition_note: Clearer whole-mausoleum context, but small casket, faded/dim photo; not proven a superior close-up.

review_scope_note: B20 provides newer file-page and original-render evidence. It neither changes B19's KEEP decisions nor clears its publication holds.
